def plus_one(A):
    A[-1] += 1  # 最好一个元素加1
    for i in reversed(range(1, len(A))):  # 注意 reversed
        if A[i] != 10:
            break
        A[i] = 0
        A[i-1] += 1
    if A[0] == 10:
        A[0] = 1
        A.append(0)
    return A
